let sourceText: string | number = "hi";
function textMetadata() {}
textMetadata.value = sourceText;
function readText() { return textMetadata.value.toUpperCase(); }
sourceText = 3;
console.log(readText());

let sourceNumber: string | number = 1;
const numberMetadata = () => {};
numberMetadata.value = sourceNumber;
function readNumber() { return numberMetadata.value.toFixed(1); }
sourceNumber = "changed";
console.log(readNumber());
